release_notes:
Fix auto-catalog field/name corruption and admin UI bugs

* Fix auto-catalog field/name corruption and admin UI bugs

Auto-catalog & custom-field sync (root cause):
- Dhru's CUSTOM.bulk flag was only cached when CUSTOM.allow==1, silently
  dropping bulk-IMEI-capable services (seen on IMEISTAR) and starving an
  existing serviceimei-mistag guard, so the real IMEI input box was wrongly
  hidden on those services (cron/apiserviceprices.php,
  admincp/include/ajax/modules/sync_dhru_imeiservices.php).
- Same bulk-vs-serviceimei guard applied to the manual "Sync Custom Field
  Attachments" tool (admincp/include/php/functions.php).
- gf_autoadd_create_staged() hard-capped auto-discovered service names at
  150 chars regardless of actual column width (255/250), truncating long
  supplier names mid-string (cron/functions.php).

Category / label fixes:
- category.php: duplicate/archived-category block message was always
  styled as a green success alert even when it was actually blocking
  creation; now shows red when it's a real error.
- serverservices.php + languages/english.php: category filter dropdown
  used the wrong language vars (showed "Server Services" / a payment-method
  placeholder instead of "Service Category" / "Choose a Category...").

Dashboard / mobile UI fixes:
- dashboard_orders.php + fresh-admin.css: mobile status dropdown showed
  stale labels (New/Accepted/Order History) instead of the real statuses
  (Pending/Completed/Rejected/In Process); a positional CSS rule assumed
  the first list item was always a non-clickable header and was silently
  hiding a real working link.
- bulksearchsection.php: mobile search-filter collapse could get stuck
  hidden because a leftover display-hide class from the desktop
  expand/collapse mechanism was never cleared.

New admin feature:
- newservices.php: "Pending Review" page for auto-discovered staged
  drafts — bulk/single delete (tombstones so the cron won't rediscover),
  revive/dismiss for disconnected-then-reconnected services.

Data-integrity fixes:
- codes.php: manual-verify bulk action now reports a real success count.
- serverservice.php: staged Server-service save was writing to the wrong
  column (CustomFieldId instead of DBCustomField).

No database migration needed — no schema changes in this set. The
corrupted-data cleanup for the field/name bugs above was applied directly
to the two affected customer installs as a one-off, not shipped via the
migration system (each install's corrupted rows differed and were
reconciled live against that install's own supplier API).

* docs: correct publish-update workflow description

The doc described an older manual-tag, version-named-migration-file
flow. The actual workflow (.github/workflows/publish-update.yml) has
since moved to: trigger on every merge to main (not just version.txt),
auto-bump the patch version from the latest tag, full catch-up builds
(not diffs) with a cumulative deleted-files list, and ship every
migrations/*.sql file (tracked per-install) rather than a single
version-named file. Corrected each section to match, and documented
the legacy db.sql bridge that the version-named convention still
serves for old updaters.
